description: Stream & torrent anime from your terminal
#: hash is maintained by the scoop-bucket repo's autoupdate flow; leaving it unset is safer than a stale value.
notes: Torrent support depends on a Python wheel for libtorrent and may not be available for every Python version - site streaming always works regardless.
pre_install: if (-not $bashExe) { Write-Host '[ani-cli] bash.exe not found - is the git dependency installed?' -ForegroundColor Red; return }
Scoop installs run.sh without the executable bit; invoke via bash explicitly so the launcher is robust.
post_install: Write-Host '[ani-cli] Attempting optional torrent support (pip install libtorrent)...' -ForegroundColor Cyan
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '[ani-cli] libtorrent wheel unavailable for this Python version - site streaming still works, torrent will not.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }
